config.label: LND REST API URL (recommended wallet; pair with LND_MACAROON)
config.description: LND REST API URL (recommended wallet; pair with LND_MACAROON). A wallet is optional — without one, free tools and marketplace search still work; paid calls return their payment challenge.

config.label: Hex-encoded macaroon for LND (use a pay-scoped macaroon in production)
config.description: Hex-encoded macaroon for LND (use a pay-scoped macaroon in production). Required with LND_REST_HOST.

config.label: Nostr Wallet Connect string — easiest setup, works with CoinOS, Alby Hub, Zeus, and more
config.description: Nostr Wallet Connect string — easiest setup, works with CoinOS, Alby Hub, Zeus, and more. Alternative to LND.

config.label: LNbits instance URL (pair with LNBITS_ADMIN_KEY)
config.description: LNbits instance URL (pair with LNBITS_ADMIN_KEY). Alternative wallet.

config.label: Admin API key for LNbits
config.description: Admin API key for LNbits. Required with LNBITS_URL.

config.label: Phoenixd HTTP API URL (pair with PHOENIXD_PASSWORD)
config.description: Phoenixd HTTP API URL (pair with PHOENIXD_PASSWORD). Alternative wallet.

config.label: HTTP password for Phoenixd
config.description: HTTP password for Phoenixd. Required with PHOENIXD_URL.

config.label: Maximum sats the server may spend per session (process lifetime), across ALL sources
config.description: Maximum sats the server may spend per session (process lifetime), across ALL sources. Unset = unlimited; 0 = free tools only. The config file's budget.sat takes precedence.

config.label: Account token for tools that act on YOUR bolthub account (workspace, listing, audit, earnings, and node tools)
config.description: Account token for tools that act on YOUR bolthub account (workspace, listing, audit, earnings, and node tools). Optional even for those: the connect_account tool pairs via the browser instead. Never needed to discover, call, or pay for APIs — buying is account-less.
